decisions.statement: A namespace names an area a person narrows by rather than restating a command under it.
A namespace's parts are the commands, namespaces and modules spelled under the namespace.
A command's slug opens with the slug of its namespace and a hyphen.
A namespace under another namespace opens its own slug with the outer slug and a hyphen.
A command's parent is its namespace rather than a domain.
A namespace under another namespace is a part of the outer namespace.
A namespace under no namespace is a part of the `command` page type.
Every node of the command tree is a page.
A command is reached by walking the parts from the root.
The walk takes one word at a time.
A word naming no part of the node reached stops the walk.
A namespace adds no scope for a slug to be unique within.
A namespace has no code of its own.
A module more than one command of a namespace reaches sits under that namespace.

definition: a domain gathering the commands whose slugs open with its own and a hyphen
